policy.source: NBP; MPC held on 3-4 Nov 2026 (strefainwestorow.pl/gospodarka/rpp-decyzja-listopad-2026; Bank Millennium daily 5 Nov 2026)

money_market.source: WIBOR 1M/3M/6M/1Y 6 Nov 2026 fixing: 3.73/3.89/3.97/4.03 (Pekao BH archive, totalmoney.pl; 3M also LSEG via Bank Millennium). POLSTR O/N 3.766% (5 Nov), 3M compounded 3.523% (GPW Benchmark). Repo: Treasury BondSpot Poland session 6 Nov 2026 (special repo 1W 3.65-3.67%, GC O/N avg 3.885%). Funding rate used for carry = 3.70% (between special repo and POLSTR/GC).

irs.source: PLN IRS vs 6M WIBOR, full curve 1Y-20Y at the 6 Nov 2026 close (BlueGamma interdealer mids; 2Y/5Y/10Y identical to LSEG via Bank Millennium). Interpolated with monotone PCHIP through 6M WIBOR and the pillars; beyond 20Y the last slope is extrapolated at half speed.

notes: Bond prices: Treasury BondSpot Poland fixing (morning fix) 9 Nov 2026; OK0127/WS0437/WS0447 have no fixing -> mid of best bid/offer from the 6 Nov session summary.
Settlement T+2 business days (11 Nov is a Polish holiday) -> 12 Nov 2026.

curve.source: Nelson-Siegel-Svensson zero curve fitted to BondSpot fixings (yield-error weighted). Front end anchored at a 3M zero of 3.45% (short POLGBs PS0527/DS0727 3.47-3.55%, T-bills 3.5-3.95% bid/ask, special repo 3.63-3.70%), so roll-down into the sub-1Y area is not an extrapolation artefact.

macro.cpi_note: fuel-price programme CPN (to end-2026) pulled October down; NBP Nov projection CPI 3.1% 2026 / 4.2% 2027 / 2.8% 2028 (constant rates)
macro.ratings: S&P (6 Nov): FC A- affirmed, LC cut A->A-, outlook negative on both; Fitch A- negative; Moody's A3 stable
macro.hike_pricing_note: Bank Millennium (2 Nov): market priced ~125bp of hikes over 12M; FRAs fell sharply 4-6 Nov. MPC hawks (Wnorowski, Zarzecki) flag Dec/Jan hike risk; PAP consensus: hold to Q3 2027; ING: +50bp in Q1 2027.

portfolio_meta._source: GPW Benchmark, 'Portfele obligacji' communique of 28 Oct 2026 (portfolio after periodic change on 30 Oct 2026). Units = number of bonds (1,000 PLN nominal each) included in the index portfolio.
